paths.title: Start by reading the BOM
paths.desc: Check the item name, thread designation, grade and equivalent standard in order.

steps.title: Item and shape
steps.desc: Distinguish the roles of bolts, studs and nuts.

steps.title: Thread designation
steps.desc: Read metric and inch designations and check the tolerance.

steps.title: Material and grade
steps.desc: Distinguish the dimensional standard from the strength grade.

steps.title: Equivalent standards and documents
steps.desc: Check standard changes and the inspection documents required.

paths.title: Flange bolting review
paths.desc: Read through from stud specification to preload and assembly sequence.

steps.title: Shape and length
steps.desc: Check the flange conditions and the length measurement basis.

steps.title: Bolt and nut grades
steps.desc: Check the bolting material and the requirements for the mating nut.

steps.title: Preload and friction
steps.desc: Read the relationship between torque and clamp force, and the effect of friction.

steps.title: Assembly and control
steps.desc: Look at assembly instructions, tightening sequence and tensioning.

paths.title: Machine and shaft assembly review
paths.desc: Find the different roles of threaded fastening and of pins, keys and retaining rings.

steps.title: Fastening shape
steps.desc: Distinguish the uses of socket head cap screws and set screws.

steps.title: Threads and holes
steps.desc: Check engagement length, clearance holes and tap drill holes.

steps.title: Positioning and shaft connection
steps.desc: Look at pins, keys and retaining rings by role.

steps.title: Keeping the joint tight
steps.desc: Read about the causes of loosening, fatigue and galling.

paths.title: Purchase decision → BOM check
paths.desc: Without estimating, link confirmed conditions and unconfirmed questions to the quotation line.

steps.title: Inch or metric
steps.desc: Check the unit system of the drawing first.

steps.title: Check the thread designation
steps.desc: Check the nominal size, pitch or TPI, tolerance and internal/external thread together.

steps.title: Check grade and material
steps.desc: Check the grade of each of the bolt and nut, the standard edition and whether substitution is allowed.

steps.title: Check surface treatment and service conditions
steps.desc: Record the coating system, temperature, salinity and sour service requirements.

steps.title: Ask about required documents
steps.desc: Check the document type, heat/lot, tests and whether they can be supplied.

steps.title: Reflect in the BOM
steps.desc: Link the confirmation questions to the original line number. Leave unknown values as unconfirmed.
